des: Create a .mcp_server_settings.json file in the data directory; you can pick from the MCP services below or add new MCP services yourself.
More useful mcp services will be tested and added over time; contributions are welcome.
Remember to delete the comment lines; the des property is only a description and is not parsed.
The des and link properties only describe how to install and make the original links easy to find; they are not required.
Three transport modes are currently supported: stdio (standard input/output), sse (Server-Sent Events), streamable-http (streaming HTTP).

streamable-http-mcp-server.des: Uses the Streamable HTTP transport mode, suitable for web deployment in production
